name: Crime & mystery
description: Perfect crimes, prime suspects and great mysteries.

crimen-quien-cometeria-el-crimen-perfect.text: Who would commit the perfect crime and never get caught?

crimen-quien-confesaria-entre-lagrimas-a.text: Who would confess in tears at the very first interrogation?

crimen-quien-seria-el-cerebro-de-una-ban.text: Who would be the mastermind of a criminal gang?

crimen-quien-acabaria-detenido-por-la-to.text: Who would end up arrested for the most ridiculous thing?

crimen-quien-parece-el-mas-inocente-pero.text: Who looks the most innocent but hides the darkest side?

crimen-a-quien-acusarian-primero-si-apar.text: Who would everyone blame first if a body turned up at a group dinner?

crimen-quien-se-libraria-de-una-multa-ha.text: Who would sweet-talk their way out of a ticket?

crimen-que-dos-personas-formarian-el-duo.text: Which two people would make the most feared criminal duo?

crimen-que-dos-personas-se-delatarian-mu.text: Which two people would rat each other out the moment they felt a bit of pressure?

options: The getaway driver, and that's it

crimen-si-tuvieras-que-cometer-un-crimen.text: If you had to commit one crime and get away with it, which one?
options: A million-dollar hack from your couch
Stealing a painting from a museum

options: What's going on in the Bermuda Triangle
Whether we're alone in the universe
